title: Boosted Board Commute Delay by Battery Band
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session platform="boosted" battery_pct_band=* delay_min=*
| stats avg(delay_min) as avg_delay_min, count as events by battery_pct_band
| sort - avg_delay_min
description: Shows average commute delay minutes by battery band for Boosted board commutes.
value: Average commute delay minutes by battery band helps compare Boosted board commutes across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `delay_min` on `ride:session` events and normalize `battery_pct_band` so Splunk can summarize performance by battery band.
visualization: Bar chart of average commute delay minutes by battery band.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors the average commute delay minutes for each battery band so you can see what works best for Boosted board commutes.
